device: Android API 36 emulator (AVD fm-members-frames, leased copy), wm size 412x915, density 160 (1 px = 1 dp), font_scale 1.3
method: Pixel analysis of the unedited screenshots with measure.py (PIL). Divider = last row of the 2 px full-width rule under the filter row (y=158-159). Label = first contiguous run of rows with ink (>60 RGB-sum difference from background) in the ROOMS label column x=16..90. Card top = first row below the label where the card border spans >90% of x=40..350. Distances count the background rows strictly between the two edges. Cross-checked against uiautomator bounds: ROOMS TextView [16,191][..,211] and first row [17,216][395,285] are identical on main and after.

rooms_header_desktop_1279x936_scale1.note: Same pixel method; divider y=105, label column x=16..60. Main and before put the + in a 44 px box, so their header is taller; after holds the + to one label line.
rooms_header_desktop_1279x936_scale1.main_first_row_top_method: main's first row is read (untinted); its top is the second row's tint top (259) minus the 82 px row pitch
